drafted_from: tool:copy-a-site's row in tools/copy-a-site/tool-rows.json, do-work/copy-a-site.mjs and test/copy-a-site.test.mjs with its test/site.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Copy the website at https://example.com/ into files I can publish as a public app, at most 10 pages." It runs tool:copy-a-site and hands back site.json in your files with every page, picture, style and font it could copy and a list of what it could not.
no_lists_because: It keeps and reads no list: it takes a web address, copies the public site and answers one site.json file in your files.
instructions: 1. Pick the site's first page as a plain web address (http or https, no user name or password, no query), for example https://example.com/.

2. Say "Copy this website" and give your AI the address; add max_pages (1 to 200, default 60), paths for pages no link reaches (like ["/pricing"]) and width (320 to 2560, default 1280) when you need them.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:copy-a-site and that input (the worked example shows one). It runs in the door's container with internet and takes about four minutes.

4. Read what comes back: result.pages (the pages copied), result.files and result.bytes, result.skipped (what could not be copied and why; those links stay on the original site) and result.remaining_paths; files.site is site.json, { files: { path: contents } }.

5. When result.remaining_paths is not empty the page limit was reached: run it again with those paths in paths and the pages already copied in exclude_paths. Hand files.site's files to publish_public_app_definition to publish the copy.

worked_examples.title: A three-page site copied, scripts removed, links pointing at the copy
worked_examples.ask: Copy the website at http://copy-a-site.example/ into files I can publish, at most 10 pages.
worked_examples.given: From tools/copy-a-site/test/copy-a-site.test.mjs with its test site test/site.mjs (a home page whose words a script draws, a /guides/first page linked from it, a /listed-only page found only in the sitemap, one style sheet using a picture, two pictures and a favicon); the test runs the script with --url http://copy-a-site.example/ --max-pages 10 through a proxy, since that name resolves nowhere else.
worked_examples.hands_back: result.origin is http://copy-a-site.example; result.pages holds the three pages /, /guides/first and /listed-only; result.files is 7 and the files in site.json are favicon.ico, guides/first/index.html, index.html, listed-only/index.html, look/site.css, pictures/ball.png and pictures/court.png. index.html keeps the words the script drew ("Drawn by the page") with the script and onclick removed, its link to the guide reads href="/guides/first", its link to https://elsewhere.example/ is unchanged, the form and buttons are replaced by words like "Ask on the original site", and look/site.css points its picture at /pictures/ball.png. files.site names the saved site.json.
